title: NHK Web やさしい日本語 — 桜の季節 (Cherry Blossom Season)
description: NHK's easy Japanese news service for language learners. This segment covers Japan's cherry blossom season: bloom forecasts, hanami (flower-viewing) traditions, and the cultural meaning of sakura and 'mono no aware'. Vocabulary and grammar are kept at N5–N4 level with furigana on the original site.
